summary: Find the lost treasures and experience ancient legends!
description:
Jewel Lost Legacy ⚔

Join adventurer Selina on a mysterious journey to uncover the lost legacy! Step into a fantastic world filled with ancient ruins and hidden treasures! 

Explore captivating missions and stunning graphics! Dive into the world of top-quality puzzle games today.

[Description]
Match the sparkling jewels and align them to form the same shapes.
Complete hidden missions and discover the treasures hidden within!

Join this exciting puzzle adventure for free now!

[How to Play]
Enjoy dozens of unique mission challenges!
No need to worry about Wi-Fi!
Play offline without an internet connection!
Explore colorful graphics and unique missions!
Take on 500+ different stages filled with fun and challenges!

[Important Information]
1. If the game does not save properly, all data will reset when the application is deleted.
Additionally, data will reset when switching devices.
2. The app is free to play, but offers in-game currency, items, and paid products (like ad removal).
3. Includes visual, banner, and interstitial ads.

If you encounter any issues, feel free to contact us by email!
We're here to help you right away!
